events.title: Early Food & Wood Automation - Impurity 0.3.3
events.summary: Version 0.3.3 is now live for the Impurity demo. Resource automation is something requested by a lot of people. This was reserved for later researches, but I have introduced some food & wood early automations to make tedious gathering easier for people who want to explore more.Below are the changes:New feature : Animal traps Builder can craft them, and you can place them providing some early food automation. events.title: Impurity Demo - 0.3.2d
events.summary: Version 0.3.2d is now live for the Impurity demo.Below are the changes:Every neutral creature in the world now drop dusks (non animals, non bosses)The companions now heal hourly when in the settlement (not in combat or party)Parrying now will cancel basic attacks, allowing to parry while in an attack animationThe window to parry increased from 0.28s to 0.35s, making it easier to land oneHarvest rate of tools is increased (Meaning faster hatchet and pickaxe animation speed)Added tutorial for comp

events.title: Impurity Demo - Patch 0.3.2c
events.summary: Patch 0.3.2c is now live for the Impurity demo.Below are the changes:Added tutorial for crafting a wooden bowl and graven calm.Added tutorial text to explain companion farming mode, and waking up companions from their sleepIncreased yield of wood from treesIncreased food value of roasted meat, mushrooms, carrots, hazelnutsAdded a tutorial to visit the trader when you arrive at an NPC settlementSome other minor changes

events.title: Impurity at Steam Next Fest + Devlog #3
events.summary: The public demo is available to play throughout the event, giving you a chance to explore the world, fight enemies, recruit companions, gather resources, and begin building your settlement.I’ve also released Devlog #3, covering the latest progress on the game and what I’ve been working on recently.If you haven’t tried the demo yet, now is a great time to jump in!As always, feedback and bug reports are extremely helpful while development continues.Thanks for all the support! - Jim, Dev of Impurit

events.title: Impurity Demo - Hotfix 0.3.2b

events.title: The Impurity Demo Is Now Available
events.summary: The Impurity demo is now available on Steam.Explore a dark fantasy world, build and manage your settlement, recruit companions, fight dangerous creatures and factions, and shape your path through purity or corruption.The demo is now available, and I’ll continue improving it in the lead-up to Steam Next Fest, October 19-26.If you encounter any issues or want to share feedback, you can join the Impurity Discord directly through the button in-game.Play the demo now and wishlist Impurity on Steam!

events.title: 1000 Wishlists! Devlog #2 is Live
events.summary: 1000 Wishlists 🎉 Thanks a lot for the support so far, it really means a lot. Devlog #2 is now live, where I go deeper into the core systems of Impurity. This time I focus on: - Colony management and how companions behave - Jobs, resources, and settlement growth - How player-driven gameplay connects with these systems The goal is to keep the feeling of a colony sim with survival elements, but without overwhelming micromanagement, since you only control one character directly. events.title: Creating a Dark Fantasy Open World RPG
events.summary: The Steam page for Impurity is now live.In this first devlog I show the vision behind the game: a dark fantasy procedural open world where you explore dangerous lands, recruit companions, encounter foreign factions and build a colony while choosing between pure or unholy powers.Watch the devlog and consider wishlisting the game if it interests you!
